mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStat */ USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getUserTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , CONCAT('닉네임: ', U.USER_NICK , CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(U.INTR_CNTN), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('\n한줄소개: ', U.INTR_CNTN) END) AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT /* getReportTargetDtl */ R.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , COALESCE(R.REPT_CNTN, '') AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_REPORT R JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' WHERE R.REPT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND R.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND R.PUBC_YSNO = 'Y'

SELECT /* getReplyTargetDtl */ C.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , COALESCE(C.REPL_CNTN, '') AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TB_REPLXX C JOIN TM_REPORT R ON R.REPT_NUMB = C.REPT_NUMB AND R.PUBC_YSNO = 'Y' JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' WHERE C.REPL_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND C.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND COALESCE(C.DELT_YSNO, 'N') = 'N'
